glossZh: 责备，指责；（名词）过失，受责怪之处
glossEn: a reproach for some lapse or misdeed
note: a reproach for some lapse or misdeed。线索：lay / put the blame on sb（接 s2）。名词侧含「过失」义（blame = fault）。

glossEn: put or pin the blame on / attribute responsibility to
note: put or pin the blame on / attribute responsibility to。必带 on 或 upon。线索：blame it on me / blame him for the delay。
harass with constant criticism。罕见但真实：They blamed him constantly for every error. 现有中文无此义项，属新增。
